Accra, Ghana and Kigali, Rwanda — January 12, 2026 — Bio Usawa Biotechnology Ltd. (Bio Usawa, Inc.) today announced that the Ghana Food and Drugs Authority (Ghana FDA) has approved BioUcenta™, a biosimilar to Lucentis® (ranibizumab), for the treatment of diabetic macular edema, age-related macular degeneration, and diabetic retinopathy. This approval follows closely on the heels of authorization by the Rwanda FDA, underscoring growing regulatory momentum for biosimilars across Africa and paving the way for broader regional access to life-saving biologic therapies. BioUcenta™ is licensed exclusively to Bio Usawa for Sub-Saharan Africa by Bioeq AG. The Ghana FDA’s approval was granted following a rigorous, science-based regulatory review that referenced comprehensive data previously evaluated and accepted by the European Medicines Agency (EMA).
